slides.title: Pim sorts the post
slides.text: Pim the owl sorts the morning post at the Netville post office. Every message must reach the right house, safe and whole.
slides.alt: Break It Up: packet 1 of the apple picture has left Pim's Post and rides the road towards Mill Office and Grandma's House.

focus.cue: Packet 2 waits its turn at Pim's Post
Its trip: through Mill Office to Grandma's House

slides.title: Too big for one envelope
slides.text: A photo is too big for one envelope. Pim cuts it into small numbered pieces called packets, so each piece can travel on its own.
slides.alt: Break it up: a picture of an apple is too big to send in one go, so the network cuts it into small numbered packets.

focus.cue: One picture, too big to send in one go
Cut into small numbered packets, each on its own road

slides.title: Different roads
slides.text: Packets travel different roads through routers, which are other post offices along the way. If one road closes, a packet can take another road instead.
slides.alt: Many roads to the school: packets can go by Hill Office or River Office, and one road will close.

focus.cue: Packets travel the roads from office to office
Two roads lead on to The School: either can carry a packet

slides.title: Back together again
slides.text: Packets can arrive mixed up at the far end. Their numbers show the right order, so the far end can rebuild the whole photo.
steps: packets 1 and 2 are already in place
tap each one in number order
the far end rebuilds the whole picture
slides.alt: All six packets are here: 1 and 2 are back in place, and 3, 4, 5 and 6 wait to be tapped in number order.

focus.cue: Packets can arrive mixed up at the far end
Their numbers show the right order
The far end rebuilds the picture from the numbers

slides.title: Hands that could peek
slides.text: Every hand that carries a packet could peek inside it. That is why later steps teach seals and locks to keep messages private.
slides.alt: Break It Up, level 4: five packets for the zoo. Every road on the map meets at the Center Office before Zoo Gate.

focus.cue: Every road here meets at the Center Office
Every office and router on the way handles the packet

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Break It Up and finish all 5 levels, then play all 4 levels of Many Roads. Watch the number on every packet.
slides.alt: Grandma's apple picture, cut into 3 numbered packets: packet 2 is on its way down the road.

focus.cue: Play Break It Up: watch the number on every packet
